Notice that by starting from A instead of C, a different intervallic formula evolves: W-H-W-W-H-W-W. (Remember, the major scale is W-W-H-W-W-W-H.) This explains the melodic contrast of the two scales, even though they are related. As an exper- iment, play through the example in Fig. 13. Hear the difference? Even though the two scales share the same notes, they sound quite unalike.
